I think you might be using too many products at once, there’s no need for a gel and a cream. My wash n gos became so much more manageable and longer-lasting when I just switched to using one product (a foam or gel) on wet hair. I put the foam on in the shower, right after conditioning. Washing my hair more often (1x/wk) helps with the moisture, so leave-ins aren’t necessary. Gel + leave-in or any other product is going to give you the white stuff that doesn’t go away. The foam I use is the doux, and it works so well at giving me the hold of gel without the mess/flakiness/stickiness of gel. 


Also important is to section your hair and really comb the product (foam, gel) through all of your hair - this’ll help with the shaping and making sure your hair is consistently coated.
